title: When does deep reinforcement learning pay off in HVAC supervisory control? Four small Modelica case studies trained directly on FMUs
abstract: arXiv:2611.22144v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) is often proposed for the supervisory control of heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems. The reported gains are, however, difficult to interpret, because the baselines are often weak and the attainable optimum is seldom known. This paper examines four small, reproducible case studies based on an office building in Brisbane, Australia: pre-cooling under a time-of-use tariff; chiller staging with condenser water reset; chilled water supply temperature reset with a wet cooling coil; and chilled water storage under time-of-use prices and a demand charge. The plants were modelled with the Modelica Buildings library, and in three of the cases a soft actor-critic agent was trained directly on the exported functional mock-up unit (FMU). translated_title: 深度强化学习在暖通空调（HVAC）监督控制中何时才有收益？四个直接在FMU上训练的小型Modelica案例研究
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习（DRL）常被提议用于供暖、通风与空调（HVAC）系统的监督控制，但其所报告的收益难以解读，因为所用的基准控制器往往较弱，且可达到的最优解鲜为人知。本文基于澳大利亚布里斯班的一栋办公楼开展了四个小型、可复现的案例研究：分时电价下的预冷、带冷凝器水温重置的冷水机组台数控制、带湿式冷却盘管的冷冻水供水温度重置，以及分时电价与需量电费下的冷冻水蓄冷。这些被控对象采用Modelica Buildings库建模，其中三个案例中的软演员-评论家（soft actor-critic）智能体直接在导出的功能样机单元（FMU）上进行训练。每个智能体均与经过调优的基于规则的控制器进行比较，并在可行的情况下，与通过逐时穷举搜索或动态规划获得的近最优参考基准进行比较。
tldr: 该论文通过四个基于Modelica模型并直接在FMU上训练SAC智能体的小型可复现HVAC案例研究，与调优的规则控制器及近最优基准进行对比，阐明了深度强化学习在HVAC监督控制中何时才真正划算。
en_tdlr: This paper clarifies when deep reinforcement learning pays off in HVAC supervisory control through four small reproducible Modelica case studies with SAC agents trained directly on FMUs and benchmarked against tuned rule-based controllers and near-optimal references.
